name: Akachōchin
description: Akachōchin — An izakaya theme laid out as a card mosaic in shu vermilion (#EB6101), the main colour on the full hero field, the page heads, the menu overlay and the mosaic cards, with sumi brown-black, warm paper and deep vermilion links; Reggae One display over Sawarabi Gothic. The pictures are documentary-style photographs (35 mm, available light, handheld, fine grain, graded toward vermilion): the hero is a pair of tall vertical banners, a sumi nobori with the shop name set vertically beside a tall photograph of the lantern alley, with a red paper lantern as a transparent cut-out hanging over both; a cut-out sake flask breaks out of its vermilion card in the mosaic. A full top header: the shop name, a Reserve a seat button and a menu button that opens a full-screen vermilion overlay. Vertical Japanese only on Japanese text; English always runs horizontally. Tonight's board and the shop details are synced patterns edited in one place. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b3-19 (card-mosaic archetype, vertical-banner hero, overlay nav, real-photography images, documentary photo direction, shu #EB6101, Reggae One + Sawarabi Gothic). Contrast: sumi brown-black #1E1009 on shu vermilion #EB6101 5.5:1 (all text on the hero field, page heads, the menu overlay and the vermilion cards); white on sumi 18.5:1; shu on sumi 5.5:1 (header tag line, nobori caption, footer name, header button); sumi on warm paper #FBF1E7 16.6:1; deep vermilion #A63E00 on paper 5.7:1 and on white 6.3:1; quiet #5C4234 on paper 8.2:1 and on white 9.2:1; white on shu only 3.4:1, never used for text.

fonts.role: display: headings, the shop name, vertical Japanese labels, prices and the overlay menu

summary.zh-TW: 紀實攝影風的居酒屋網站：朱紅色主視覺以直書布旗與巷弄照片組成直幅旗幟，去背紅燈籠垂掛其上；首頁是卡片拼貼，德利酒壺衝出色卡。
summary.en: A documentary-photo izakaya site: a vermilion hero of tall banners with a cut-out red lantern, and a card mosaic a sake flask breaks out of.
summary.ja: 記録写真風の居酒屋サイト。朱色のヒーローに縦書きの幟と路地の写真、切り抜きの赤提灯。カードのモザイクから徳利が飛び出します。
summary.fr: Un izakaya en photo documentaire : héros vermillon en bannières verticales, lanterne détourée, mosaïque de cartes où déborde un flacon.
summary.de: Eine Izakaya in Reportagefotos: zinnoberroter Hero aus Hochbannern mit freigestellter Laterne, Kartenmosaik mit Sake-Flasche.
